title: Model
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0801, 0.0801) with a radius of 0.0801. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0321. Repeat this process for the second face, placing the circles at (0.0801, 0.5957). For the third face, draw the circles at (0.6699, 0.0801), and for the fourth face, place them at (0.6699, 0.5957). After completing the four faces, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust the size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model without any additional transformations, as the initial settings are already optimized. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.016 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the model will be a length of 0.7500000533437796 units, a width of 0.6758197505007296 units, and a height of 0.01602671746232075 units.

inner_radius = 0.0321

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Parameters
outer_d = 0.14    # washer outer diameter
hole_d = 0.07     # washer hole diameter
thickness = 0.016 # washer thickness

# Washer positions (X, Y)
positions = [
    (0.07, 0.07),
    (0.68, 0.07),
    (0.07, 0.6058),
    (0.68, 0.6058),
]

# Build first washer
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(positions[0][0], positions[0][1])
    .circle(outer_d / 2.0)
    .circle(hole_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# Add remaining washers
for (x, y) in positions[1:]:
    washer = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(x, y)
        .circle(outer_d / 2.0)
        .circle(hole_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(thickness)
    )
    r = r.union(washer)

import cadquery as cq

# Four identical flat annular washers, arranged 2 x 2
outer_r = 0.075      # OD = 0.150
inner_r = 0.0375     # ID = 0.075
thick = 0.016

washer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_r).circle(inner_r).extrude(thick)

x_centers = [0.075, 0.675]          # X extent: 0.000 to 0.750
y_centers = [0.075, 0.6008]         # Y extent: 0.000 to 0.6758

r = None
for x in x_centers:
    for y in y_centers:
        w = washer.translate((x, y, 0))
        r = w if r is None else r.union(w)
